name: outbound-smtp-relay
title: Outbound SMTP relay over implicit TLS
description: Deliver queued mail through a fixed authenticated SMTP relay on TCP 465 for cloud environments that block outbound TCP 25.
scope: cmd/octo-mail config and composition, mailflow/submit transport, docs, tests
creator: codex
notes: Tracks https://github.com/Mininglamp-OSS/octo-mail/issues/56. Based on Tencent Cloud CVM guidance for using third-party SMTP services over port 465 when outbound TCP 25 is blocked.
